product_desc: raw cut pork ribs in a black retail tray, meaty and pale pink with clean white bone ends. Frame the meat and the bare tray rim only: the printed label and barcode sit outside the shot, and no text of any kind appears in frame
cook: a professional chef in their thirties, dark chef coat with sleeves rolled to the forearm, focused and precise
kitchen: a clean semi-professional kitchen with stainless surfaces and a gas wok range, warm directional light, a few Thai aromatics visible in small bowls
prep_subject: raw pork rib pieces marinating in a shallow steel tray, coated in a red-orange marinade, with lemongrass stalks, sliced red chilli, kaffir lime leaves and garlic arranged beside them. A pair of tongs rests flat at the far side
prep_defines: the rib size and the marinade colour
cook_vessel: a deep wok of clear hot oil over a gas flame
cook_subject: the ribs frying, their surface turning deep golden-brown and crisp, oil bubbling vigorously around them, steam rising. The ribs sit proud of the oil rather than submerged
cook_negatives: pale undercooked meat, black burnt crust, batter coating, boiling in water, thin watery sauce
hero_subject: the finished ribs stacked in a tall pile on a dark plate, glazed in a glossy red-orange sauce, scattered with fried garlic, sliced red chilli and coriander, a lime wedge at the edge
hero_setting: a dark slate surface with a banana leaf underneath, dramatic warm side light
story: ribs into hot oil, turning golden
negatives_global: western barbecue ribs, sweet red bbq sauce, boiled meat, batter, ketchup colour, cheese
first_heat: The ribs enter the oil and it erupts around them in a rolling boil of bubbles, their surface stiffening and beginning to colour almost at once, steam and haze rising above the wok.
transform: the ribs turn from pale marinated red to deep golden-brown, their surface crisping and blistering, while the oil settles from a violent boil to a steady vigorous bubble around them.
lift: A pair of long tongs enters from the left, closes on one rib, lifts it clear of the oil and holds it at the centre of frame while oil runs off it in fine threads. The crust is deep golden and crisp.
plate: The hands of <Subject 1> enter from the top of frame with tongs, lift the ribs from the wok two at a time and stack them upright into a tall pile on the plate, then withdraw out of frame.
final_lift: A hand enters from the right holding chopsticks, takes one rib from the top of the stack, lifts it clear and holds it steady at the centre of frame, glaze running slowly from its end.
sound_01: A professional kitchen with a low extractor hum. In the first shot, a steel tray sliding on a stainless counter. In the second shot, lemongrass and chilli being gathered, and the wet sound of marinated ribs shifting. In the third shot, a gas burner roaring, then a violent burst of sizzling as the ribs hit hot oil. No speech.
sound_02: A heavy rolling fry throughout, oil crackling and popping. In the second shot the crackle sharpens as the crust forms. In the third shot, tongs closing, and oil running off in fine streams back into the wok. No speech.
sound_03: A kitchen with a low extractor hum. In the first shot, ribs stacking against each other on a hard plate. In the second shot, fried garlic and chilli scattering. In the third shot, chopsticks closing on a rib and a thread of glaze falling. No speech.
music: A tropical percussion bed: hand drums and bamboo blocks over a syncopated bass line, hot and driving without being frantic.
